factory.name: ButtonGroup.create
factory.signature: ButtonGroup.create(host: HTMLElement, options: ButtonGroupOptions): ButtonGroup; ButtonGroup.enhance(element: HTMLElement, options: ButtonGroupOptions): ButtonGroup

options.name: size
options.description: Size of the Buttons the group creates or enhances; defaults to the Button configuration.

options.name: buttons
options.type: readonly { text?: string; icon?: IconRef; label?: string; variant?: ButtonVariant; value?: string; disabled?: boolean }[]
options.description: create() only: Buttons to render. Icon-only buttons need a label.

options.name: attached
options.description: Shared borders and no inner radii; false spaces the buttons with a gap and lets horizontal groups wrap.

properties.name: buttons
properties.description: Direct child buttons, in DOM order.

methods.name: enhance
methods.description: Enhance an existing element containing native buttons; plain buttons become Buttons until destroy.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; a new buttons array rebuilds the Buttons.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove listeners and subscriptions, destroy created or enhanced Buttons, restore the element's role and aria-label.

events.name: aui-action
events.description: create() only: a button was activated. value defaults to the button index.

contentAreas.name: buttons
contentAreas.description: Native buttons (created from `buttons`, or the existing children with enhance()).

cssClasses.name: aui-button-group--attached
cssClasses.description: Shared borders, removed inner radii; horizontal groups scroll instead of wrapping.
